pois.label: 远端节点:方位角覆盖做定位
pois.label_en: Remote Nodes: Azimuthal Coverage for Location
pois.detail: 单台站定事件只能靠 P 偏振+S-P 距离的「单站技艺」;三个远端节点把到时差变成真正的三角定位。主站于 08-09 落位 (-700,-520) 后,坐标已由账 12 定死:A(1205,-1620)/B(-1850,-1403)/C(-1269,1605),方位 120°/232.5°/345°,近似均匀包住主站。它们同时接管纯净高频地板:24h 城市源的 8 Hz 残余要到 877 m(Q15)外才压进夜地板——主站够不到的那块由节点补齐。三点距射电阵 sci-radio-01 为 1243/2174/2408 m,均远超其 400 m 红线;UHF 回传又远在其 0.5–10 MHz 观测带之上,双重不构成 RFI。
pois.detail_en: A lone station locates events only by P polarization plus S−P distance — single-station craft; three remote nodes turn arrival-time differences into true triangulation. With the station placed at (-700,-520) on 08-09, ledger 12 fixes their coordinates: A(1205,-1620) / B(-1850,-1403) / C(-1269,1605) at azimuths 120°/232.5°/345°, wrapping the station almost evenly. They also own the pristine high-frequency floor: the 8 Hz residue of the city's 24 h sources only drops below the night floor beyond 877 m (Q15) — the nodes cover what the main station cannot. All three sit 1243/2174/2408 m from the radio array sci-radio-01 — well beyond its 400 m keep-out — and their UHF downlink lies far above its 0.5–10 MHz observing band, so it poses no RFI on either count.

specs.定位增益: GDOP 6.37e-4 /m → 面波方位 σ 1.8°(账 7 的 <5° 承诺守住),比单条 1.5 km 基线好 1.9 倍

specs_en.Location gain: GDOP 6.37e-4 /m → 1.8° surface-wave azimuth (ledger 7's <5° promise held), 1.9× better than a single 1.5 km baseline
specs_en.Terrain, measured: slopes 0.54/0.74/0.82° (engine-probed over 40 m), 1817–2048 m from the nearest city source
specs_en.Per-piece budget: type A 348 tris / type B 384 tris (≤500)

sim: 城市噪声账(mars-seis sim/03)与观测网几何:平面波前到时差最小二乘反演慢度矢量,3 站是二维解的最小闭合——与气象观测网 sci-weather-net-01 的三角定位账同构。

定点账(sim/12,10 闸全绿):主站落位后把「方位岔开 ≥90°」收成三个可施工坐标。目标最小化 GDOP=√trace((AᵀA)⁻¹),约束含地形边界、振源距离、发射下射程走廊、已落位资产净空。**两个非几何约束才是真正的裁决者**:①HiRISE 数字孪生只有 3780 m 见方,主站在西南象限使西向可用半径只剩 1160 m——纸面最优的第三点落在图幅外 629 m,那里根本没有地面;②引擎实测把首选 nodeB 否掉——那点坡度 13.5°、40 m 内高差 9.6 m,打入桩耦合不可靠。在合法方位窗口内改址后三点坡度降到 0.54–0.82°,方位分离反而从 105° 改善到 112.5°。
sim_en: City-noise ledger (mars-seis sim/03) plus network geometry: least-squares inversion of plane-wavefront arrival differences for the slowness vector needs 3 stations as the minimal 2-D closure — isomorphic to the sci-weather-net-01 triangulation ledger.

Siting ledger (sim/12, 10 gates green): with the station fixed, the 'azimuths ≥90° apart' principle becomes three buildable coordinates by minimising GDOP=√trace((AᵀA)⁻¹) subject to terrain bounds, source distance, the launch downrange corridor and clearance from placed assets. **The two non-geometric constraints turned out to be the real arbiters**: the HiRISE twin is only 3780 m across and the station sits in the southwest quadrant, so the paper optimum put the third node 629 m off the tile where no ground exists; and an in-engine probe rejected the first nodeB for sitting on a 13.5° slope with 9.6 m of relief over 40 m, where a driven stake could not couple reliably. Re-sited within the legal azimuth windows, all three slopes fall to 0.54–0.82° and the azimuth separation actually improves from 105° to 112.5°.
pois.physics: 到时差 δt = s·δx(慢度×基线):基线方位越张开,慢度两个分量的条件数越好;三站共线则法向分量不可解——这就是'方位岔开 ≥90°'的数学身份。
pois.physics_en: Arrival difference δt = s·δx (slowness × baseline): the wider the azimuths spread, the better conditioned both slowness components are; three collinear stations leave the normal component unsolvable — the mathematical identity behind 'azimuths ≥90° apart'.

pois.label: 两型节点:打入桩与基岩锚
pois.label_en: Two Node Types: Driven Stake vs Bedrock Anchor
pois.detail: A 型标准桩:尖锥打入耦合,SP 三分量罐+迷你 PV+鞭状天线,三向拉线把桅杆风振锚死——安装座那笔账在荒野同样成立。B 型基岩锚:崖边低风阻矮墩,4 岩栓直接咬进基岩,blink 信标让尘暴后的巡检车找得到它。
pois.detail_en: Type A standard stake: cone-tip driven coupling, SP 3-component pot with mini PV and whip antenna, three guy-lines pinning mast wind-buffet to ground — the mounting ledger holds in the wilderness too. Type B bedrock anchor: a low-drag squat puck at cliff edges, 4 rock bolts biting straight into bedrock, with a blink beacon so the inspection rover finds it after a dust storm.

specs.A 型: 打入桩耦合 + 拉线风振抑制,夜光状态灯
specs.B 型: 基岩 4 岩栓,风阻最低,红色 blink 信标
specs.共同点: 无转动部件 —— 安静是设计特征

specs_en.Type A: driven-stake coupling + guyed mast, night status LED
specs_en.Type B: 4 rock bolts into bedrock, lowest drag, red blink beacon
specs_en.In common: zero rotating parts — quietness is a design feature

pois.sim: 安装座账(sci-seis-01 mount 卡)外推:基岩锚接触刚度比夯实土再高一个量级,耦合共振远超频带;崖边选位与低矮外形同时压掉 Sorrells 风压项与直吹项。
pois.sim_en: Extrapolating the mount ledger (sci-seis-01 mount card): bedrock-bolt contact stiffness is another order above tamped soil, pushing coupling resonance far out of band; cliff-edge siting plus the squat profile suppresses both the Sorrells pressure term and direct wind drag.
pois.physics: 耦合刚度链条:浮土 < 夯实 < 基岩;赫兹接触 k∝G=ρVs²,基岩 Vs ~1800 m/s 对风化层 ~80 m/s 是 500 倍刚度——B 型根本没有耦合共振可言。
pois.physics_en: The coupling-stiffness ladder: loose soil < tamped < bedrock; Hertzian k∝G=ρVs², and bedrock Vs ~1800 m/s versus regolith ~80 m/s is a 500× stiffness step — type B simply has no coupling resonance to speak of.
